privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: RouteGuard is a student project for the NH-44 Jammu–Srinagar road. This page says what we collect, why, how long we keep it and how to delete it, following India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
privacy.collectAccount: Your email address, to sign in with a one-time code. Our sign-in provider, Clerk, stores it; our database doesn't. TCU sees your email, name and the role you asked for while it decides whether to approve your account.
privacy.collectProfile: Your display name, your role (grower, trader, agent or driver) and your language.
privacy.collectReports: Road reports you send: the hazard, the place on the road, an optional note and an optional photo. We remove the photo's hidden data (EXIF), including where it was taken, before we store it.
privacy.collectShipments: Shipments you add: truck number, load, destination and status.
privacy.collectLocation: Drivers only, and only if you turn it on: your latest location, rounded to about 1 km, shared only with your own transport agent.
privacy.collectAlerts: Only if you turn alerts on: your browser's push address (made by Google, Mozilla, Apple or Microsoft, not by us), the zones you follow and your language. It is deleted when you turn alerts off, sign out in that browser or delete your account. Alerts go through that company's push service.
privacy.collectAadhaar: Only if you choose the optional Aadhaar QR check: the result (checked, close or not matched), the last 4 digits of your Aadhaar number and the version of the consent and certificate. The QR, your name, date of birth, address and photo are checked in memory and never stored. It is deleted with your account.
privacy.collectLogs: Server logs: the time, a request id and a short scrambled code instead of your user id. No message contents, photos or phone numbers.
privacy.why: To show the risk on the road, to let drivers report and confirm hazards, and to let agents follow their own trucks. We don't sell data and we don't show ads.
privacy.keep: Reports leave the map when they expire (3 to 12 hours, by type of hazard) and stay in the road history. For a driver's location we keep only the latest point, and we clear it 7 days after the delivery. The record of TCU actions (the audit log) is kept for the length of the project and can't be changed.
privacy.consent: We ask you before turning on location sharing and before any identity check, and we record which version of this notice you agreed to. You can turn location sharing off at any time.
privacy.delete: You can delete your account. Your road reports then stay in the history without your name or user id.
privacy.contact: Questions about your data, or a request to correct or delete it: open an issue on our GitHub page, without personal details in it, and we answer there. Or delete your account yourself on your account page.
privacy.emergency: RouteGuard is not an emergency service. In an emergency call 112.

verify.heading: First, get verified
verify.why: Reports from drivers go on the map at once, so we take them only from verified drivers. This stops fake reports.

verify.aadhaar: Or do the Aadhaar QR check on your account page. It is optional: we keep only the result and the last 4 digits.
verify.meanwhile: Until then you can still see the map, the reports and the advice.

aadhaar.heading: Aadhaar QR check (optional)
aadhaar.what: Scan the Secure QR on your Aadhaar card or e-Aadhaar. We check UIDAI's digital signature and that the name matches your profile name. If it does, your road reports count as from a verified driver. You don't need this to use RouteGuard.
aadhaar.alreadyDone: Done: your Aadhaar QR was checked.
aadhaar.consentHeading: What we read and what we keep

consent.read: Your phone reads the QR. Only the QR text goes to our server, where we check the signature and the name.
consent.keep: We keep only: the result, the last 4 digits of your Aadhaar number, and the date. Not your name, date of birth, address or photo.
consent.never: Never type your Aadhaar number anywhere in RouteGuard. No card photo is uploaded.
consent.optional: This is optional: your transport agent can vouch for you instead. RouteGuard is a student project, not a government service.

aadhaar.agree: I agree to RouteGuard checking my Aadhaar Secure QR as described above.
aadhaar.picture: Use a picture of the QR
aadhaar.pictureNote: The picture stays on your phone. Only the QR text is sent.
aadhaar.cameraLabel: Camera view for scanning the QR
aadhaar.pointCamera: Hold the QR flat inside the square, in good light.
aadhaar.verified: Checked. Your level is now "Aadhaar checked".
aadhaar.close: The name on the card is close to your profile name but not the same, so your level stays as it was. Change your profile name to match the card exactly, then try again.

reason.name: The name on the card doesn't match your profile name. Your level stays as it was.
reason.signature: The signature didn't check out. This may not be a genuine Aadhaar Secure QR, or it is an older code. Download a new e-Aadhaar from UIDAI and try again.
reason.unreadable: We couldn't read this QR. Try again in better light.

aadhaar.notSecureQr: That isn't an Aadhaar Secure QR. Use the large QR on the card or e-Aadhaar.
aadhaar.notFound: No QR found in that picture.
aadhaar.noCamera: The camera isn't available. Allow camera access, or use a picture of the QR.
aadhaar.tooMany: Too many tries. Wait an hour and try again.
aadhaar.off: The Aadhaar check isn't available right now.
